The '''Ternin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Alchenaut sector/Legends|Alchenaut sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Western Reaches" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of [[Ternin tree sling]]s,<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ternin tree sling]]s|system=Ternin [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> a low-technology type of [[Sling/Legends|slings]].<ref name="HonorAmongThieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ternin system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square L-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
